notes.title: Update notes for 0.4.13 (August 14)
notes.content: Yesterday we noticed that you were only able to fight one of the three bosses we have in the game because of a bug. This update fixes this error, so that you can fight the other two bosses. We hope you have fun with them and let us know what you think!

tags.bug: This update fixes this error, so that you can fight the other two bosses.

notes.title: Update notes for 0.4.12 (August 13)
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We are super thankful to those of you who played the beta this first days and sent us your feedback. We are gathering all of your helpful insights and making a plan to improve the game as much as we can, but in the meantime we wanted to fix some of the most annoying bugs you reported so that you can have even more fun playing! Mac update is coming later today.

Changelog:
* Fixed the bug that prevented the beta from completing after killing the boss on the third level.
* Fixed tutorials not showing when they should for some people.
* Fixed the blue anvil looking monster not being able to damage the level 1 statue with the first ability.
* Fixed arena hordes not completing if an enemy was devoured.
* Fixed an issue when evolving into the not available characters.
* Fixed character changing unexpectedly between levels.
